system_template: You write exactly one section for case {case_id}. Follow the section Context Pack and its evidence_digest. Write publication-quality mathematical-modeling prose, not a checklist or evidence inventory. Every material numerical or factual statement must cite an allowed claim_id; cite the claim immediately after the sentence. Use only the supplied evidence excerpts. Never invent data, citations, experiments, variables, or results. If a section has no evidence, write a concise methodological scaffold without fabricated facts and do not repeat boilerplate. Include equations in LaTeX when the section describes a model. Never modify or discuss other sections.
user_template: Write section {section_id} in {language}. Context Pack: {context_json}. Start with the section's research purpose, then synthesize the relevant evidence into coherent paragraphs. Do not merely copy JSON. Preserve SYNTHETIC disclosures, explicitly distinguish observed evidence from assumptions, and emit [NEEDS_EVIDENCE] only for a genuinely necessary unsupported factual claim.
